audit.whatIsWrong: The page never names a single Ambessa ability and invents 'Repeating Dashes' as her key ability across the whole full layer. It also calls her Q a dash and her W 'poke'.
audit.why: Her real kit is Drakehound's Step (P — the dash, triggered by an attack or move command during any cast, and an auto-attack reset), Cunning Sweep into Sundering Slam (Q, 14s at rank 1), Repudiation (W, 18s — a brace with a shield that deals INCREASED damage if it blocked non-minion damage), Lacerate (E, 13s slow) and Public Execution (R, 130s — a blink that SUPPRESSES, then stuns). The dash is not on her Q, and W is not poke: hitting her brace is what powers it up, which matters enormously to Riven because Broken Wings into Ki Burst is exactly the dense burst that feeds it.
audit.corrected: Real names and cooldowns written into the focus, do/don't, cooldown breakdown, whys[4], spikes[2], wants.foe[0], wants.foe[1], early and mid. The brace interaction is stated, and the R is described as a suppress that stops you casting Valor or Ki Burst at all — not as ordinary CC.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 are yours — Ambessa's Q dashes are not online in enough quantity to outpace your combo threat, and your E shield means her W poke barely sticks. At Level 1 weave Q autos to stack Runic Blade charges and keep her honest; she cannot all-in you without her full dash chain. At Level 2 you get W and the dynamic shifts hard in your favour — bait one Q dash by stepping up, let her commit it, then close with E, W-stun before she can throw a second, and run the full Q chain. Her mobility is dash-based, not blink-based, so your W cast can track her if you read the dash direction.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours — Cunning Sweep alone does not outpace your combo threat, and Repudiation only pays off if you feed damage into her brace. At Level 1 weave Q autos to stack Runic Blade charges and keep her honest; she cannot all-in you without Drakehound's Step charged. At Level 2 you get W and the dynamic shifts hard in your favour — bait one Drakehound's Step by stepping up, let her spend it, then close with E, Ki Burst before she gets a second, and run the full Q chain. Her step is a dash, not a blink, so your W can still catch her if you read its direction.

edits.before: Level 3 is the first genuine skill check: her full Q-W combo matches your burst if she lands it clean, so do not start a trade from max range where she can dash-weave through your W. Instead force her to walk up to CS, E in on the step, and W-stun as she plants. Levels 4-5 you maintain a meaningful edge — your item lead from early should be one component ahead, and short trades on your terms will bleed her. At Level 6 the lane shifts: her R is a hard engage with built-in CC that can lock you out of casting W entirely, so respect the all-in and react with E shield into a counter-pattern rather than fighting her extended. Force all-ins only when her R is down.
edits.after: Level 3 is the first genuine skill check: Cunning Sweep into Sundering Slam matches your burst if she lands it clean, so do not open from max range where Drakehound's Step slides her out of Ki Burst. Levels 4-5 you keep a real edge — one component ahead, short trades on your terms bleed her, and never dump the Q chain into a braced Repudiation. At Level 6 the lane shifts: Public Execution suppresses, so you cannot cast anything until the slam lands. Force all-ins only on its 130s cooldown.
